item.title: [surveillance] Citizen Lab: Webloc tracked 500M devices for global law enforcement
item.description: Citizen Lab reported that law enforcement used the surveillance tool Webloc to track up to 500M devices via ad data globally. A report by Citizen Lab revealed that law enforcement agencies in the U.S., Hungary, and El Salvador used a surveillance tool called Webloc to track devices via advertising data, potentially affecting up to 500 [&#8230;]
